definitions.name: L1C.CODE1
definitions.body: 'C' BIND '([)]' C SEARCH 'P' BIND [ 1 2 -1 -2 ] P GET
definitions.note: One bracket character to its code: open paren 1, close paren -1, open square 2, close square -2.

definitions.name: L1C.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'ELT' BIND 'STK' BIND STK -1 GET 'TOP' BIND TOP ELT ADD 0 EQ 'CAN' BIND STK -1 DROP STK ELT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 CAN SELECT GET
definitions.note: Bracket reduction step (stack, code): cancel top against code when they sum to 0, else push code; stack starts as [0].

definitions.name: L1C.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 'C' BIND C 1 -1 V 0 GT SELECT ADD 0 MAX
definitions.note: Open-bracket counter step (count, code): +1 for an opener, -1 for a closer, floored at 0.

definitions.name: L1C.PSTEP
definitions.body: 'ELT' BIND 'ACC' BIND ACC 0 GET 'STK' BIND ACC 1 GET 'BST' BIND ACC 2 GET 'POS' BIND STK ELT L1C.BSTEP 'NXT' BIND POS 1 ADD 'NPS' BIND NPS BST NXT LENGTH 1 EQ SELECT 'NBS' BIND NXT NBS NPS 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: Balanced-prefix step over [stack, best, pos]: best becomes pos whenever the stack is back to its sentinel.

definitions.name: L1C.SPJOIN
definitions.note: Join a Vector of Strings with single spaces, no space at either end.

definitions.name: L1C.UP1
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Upper-case the first letter of a String, leave the rest as it is.

definitions.name: L1C.CAP
definitions.note: Title-case one word: lower-case it, then upper-case its first letter.

definitions.name: L1C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'ENTS' BIND ENTS [ 0 GET ] MAP ENTS [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Ledger entries to a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: L1C.RSTEP
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'P' BIND A 1 GET 'I' BIND I 0 1 P V EQ SELECT ADD 'NI' BIND V NI 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Run-id step (previous, id) with element: id goes up by 1 when the element differs from the previous one.

definitions.name: L1C.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ L1C.RSTEP ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector to the run id of each element; equal adjacent values share an id, ids ascend from 0.

definitions.name: L1C.ASTEP
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'P' BIND A 1 GET 'I' BIND I 0 1 P V LT SELECT ADD 'NI' BIND V NI 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Ascent-id step (previous, id) with element: id goes up by 1 unless the element is strictly greater than the previous one.

definitions.name: L1C.UPIDS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ L1C.ASTEP ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector to the id of each strictly-increasing stretch, ids ascend from 1.

definitions.name: L1C.FLAG
definitions.note: Reading to 1 when it is missing (NIL), else 0.

definitions.name: L1C.FILL
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: Forward-fill step (last present, reading): a missing reading takes the last present one.

definitions.name: L1C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of exact numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ L1C.CODE1 ] MAP 'QV' BIND [ 0 ] QV 0 [ L1C.CSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT G0C.MAXV
solutions.brackets.balanced: CHARS [ L1C.CODE1 ] MAP [ 0 ] [ L1C.BSTEP ] FOLD LENGTH 1 EQ
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS [ L1C.CODE1 ] MAP [ 0 ] 0 0 3 COLLECT [ L1C.PSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.brackets.unmatched: CHARS [ L1C.CODE1 ] MAP [ 0 ] [ L1C.BSTEP ] FOLD LENGTH 1 SUB
solutions.ledger.top_name: L1C.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: L1C.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.top_word: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ L1C.CAP ] MAP L1C.SPJOIN
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT L1C.SPJOIN
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: G0A.WORDS TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V L1C.RUNIDS V GROUP 'G' BIND G VALUES 'VS' BIND VS [ 0 GET ] MAP VS [ LENGTH ] MAP 2 COLLECT ZIP
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'V' BIND V L1C.RUNIDS V GROUP VALUES [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET 'M' BIND R VALUES G0C.MAXV 2 MUL 'MX2' BIND M NIL V LENGTH MX2 LT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'R' BIND R R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ L1C.FILL ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ L1C.FLAG ] MAP 'FL' BIND FL L1C.RUNIDS FL GROUP VALUES [ 0 GET ] MAP G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ L1C.FLAG ] MAP 'FL' BIND FL L1C.RUNIDS FL GROUP VALUES 'GV' BIND GV [ 0 GET ] MAP GV [ LENGTH ] MAP MUL G0C.MAXV
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'R' BIND R 1 DROP R -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'R' BIND R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'M' BIND R M DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'X' BIND X X L1C.MED 'M' BIND X M SUB M X SUB MAX L1C.MED
solutions.series.moving3: 'X' BIND X -2 DROP X 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD X 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'X' BIND X X 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: SORT TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
